cases.title: Settings form initial visibility and toggle behavior
cases.description: Verify that the settings form is visible upon page load and that clicking the settings button toggles its visibility correctly, handling rapid consecutive clicks without state desynchronization.

cases.title: Difficulty selection and localStorage persistence
cases.description: Verify that selecting a difficulty level updates the application state, stores the value in localStorage under the 'difficulty' key, and defaults to 'Medium' when no prior value is present.

cases.title: Random word display and correct typing handling
cases.description: Verify that a random word is displayed upon loading, and entering the correct word clears the input field, shows a new word, and increases the remaining time based on the active difficulty setting.

cases.title: Game progression, scoring, and end game state
cases.description: Verify that typing a correct word increments the score by 1, while an incorrect word leaves the input and score unchanged. Ensure the game terminates when time reaches zero and displays the end game container.

cases.title: Difficulty-based time increments on correct word entry
cases.description: Verify that entering the correct word increases the remaining time by the correct duration depending on the selected difficulty: 5 seconds for 'easy', 3 seconds for 'medium', and 2 seconds for 'hard'.

opinions.feedback: All proposed test cases are well-structured, distinct, cover all requirements properly, and are fully testable without any blockers.
All cases and expected behaviors align with the requirements and are fully testable. No blockers identified.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_51-R-1: Testable behavior includes toggling the visibility of the settings form via data-testid='settings-btn' and data-testid='settings'. Normal path: form is visible on page load, clicking toggles visibility. Abnormal/Boundary path: rapid consecutive clicks maintaining accurate state. Ambiguity: none. Requirement e2edev_bench_51-R-2: Testable behavior includes difficulty selection (Easy, Medium, Hard) via data-testid='difficulty-select', persistence in localStorage under 'difficulty', and defaulting to 'Medium'. Normal path: selecting difficulty updates storage and game mechanics. Abnormal/Boundary path: missing localStorage defaults to 'Medium'. Ambiguity: none. Requirement e2edev_bench_51-R-3: Testable behavior includes displaying random words in data-testid='word', clearing data-testid='text-input' on correct entry within time limit, and time increments (+5s easy, +3s medium, +2s hard). Normal path: correct typing triggers clear, new word, and time boost. Abnormal/Boundary path: empty or pre-populated localStorage. Ambiguity: exact predefined word list source. Requirement e2edev_bench_51-R-4: Testable behavior includes typing validation, score increment, input clearing on correct match, input retention on incorrect match, and game end state at time zero with data-testid='end-game-container'. Normal path: correct match updates score and word; zero time shows end game. Abnormal/Boundary path: incorrect typed words do not change state. Ambiguity: initial timer duration value. Requirement e2edev_bench_51-R-5: Testable behavior includes time increment mapping to difficulty ('easy'=5s, 'medium'=3s, 'hard'=2s) displayed in data-testid='time'. Normal path: correct word increases time matching selected difficulty. Abnormal/Boundary path: retrieval of invalid localStorage key defaults correctly. Ambiguity: none.
